issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אֵת מֵי הַשִּׁלֹחַ' means 'the waters of Shiloah' (a place name, the pool of Siloam). The Vietnamese renders it as 'các nước Si-lô-ê' which could be read as 'the nations of Shiloah' (nước can mean both 'water' and 'country/nation'), introducing ambiguity or a wrong concept. The Hebrew has 'waters' (מֵי), not 'nations'.
